name: embedding-viz

scripts.build:words: uv run scripts/build_embeddings.py --unit words --input In-Search-of-Lost-Time-words.txt --output public/data/embedding-map.json --title "Lost Time Words"
scripts.build:sentences: uv run scripts/build_embeddings.py --unit sentences --input In-Search-of-Lost-Time.pdf --output public/data/lost-time-sentences.json --title "Lost Time Sentences" --start-at "For a long time I used to go to bed early." --clusters 32 --batch-size 128
scripts.build:all-data: npm run build:words && npm run build:sentences

description: A WebGPU-first 3D semantic embedding atlas for words or sentences.
